LESSON: DEMOCRACY IN SCHOOL

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Citizenship and Governance in Kenya
Topic 5.4: Democracy in school
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

Welcome to this lesson on Democracy in school. In Kenyan schools, learners explore this topic to understand how it connects to daily life in our communities. A key question we explore is: 5.0 Citizenship and Governance in Kenya
